contradictions.a: Legacy firewall: prior JURNL visuals may not inform composition, image placement, background treatment or materials (L01 §2).
contradictions.b: Use the approved art-driven JURNL image as the richness benchmark (L06).
contradictions.why: The firewall did not separate legacy UI layout (to exclude) from approved brand-world authority (to inherit); the benchmark is prior JURNL visual work.
contradictions.failure: The approved world was never consumed; three thinner worlds were invented from text.

contradictions.a: Known failure = PRETTY BACKGROUND + TEXT + STACKED CARDS; do not let decorative imagery overpower comprehension; no card stacks on pretty backgrounds (L01, L02).
contradictions.b: The benchmark (F01 / F03 world) is a rich photographic background + display type + one panel (L06).
contradictions.why: The named anti-pattern and the benchmark are visually the same genre; the line between “pretty background” (bad) and “environmental richness” (good) was never defined.
contradictions.failure: Environment systematically suppressed → blank plaster, single object.

contradictions.a: Family identity must survive blurred imagery; distinctness is structural (L01 §11).
contradictions.b: Creative distinctness ≥ 8/10 dimensions incl. environment, material and depth strategy (L02 §17).
contradictions.why: Approved JURNL families share one world and differ in structure; the gate forced three different worlds.
contradictions.failure: Each concept had to invent a new world from text; none reached the shared world’s richness.

contradictions.a: Lock text, logo, nav and CTA; the generator renders the full screen (L02 §9–10).
contradictions.b: The generator may not render precision UI (L03 §5).
contradictions.why: Sequential reversal: L02 gave the generator ~19 exact strings incl. tiny labels; L03 removed text entirely. Neither tried the method that produced the approved images (reference-bound full screen + exact-text correction).
contradictions.failure: Round 2 typography failures; round 3+ lost UI–world integration.

contradictions.a: The generator may create negative space / placeholders for UI (L03 §16) → plate BLANK SURFACES.
contradictions.b: Do not use placeholder brass plates / empty wall zones as visible final output (L06).
contradictions.why: Placeholders were requested upstream and forbidden downstream; the assembly could not convincingly fill them.
contradictions.failure: Blank tags, plaques, slips and strips visible in composites.

contradictions.a: Do not use / access OpenArt (L01 DO NOT; L02 DO NOT).
contradictions.b: Use Sunburst 4K (L02 §8); use the most appropriate workflow in Opus’s environment; “no OpenArt from ChatGPT” (L01 §17, L06).
contradictions.why: The only 4K Sunburst route was banned in the same brief; the ban was later clarified as ChatGPT-only.
contradictions.failure: Round 1 local HTML renders; round 2 blocked → founder ChatGPT pass (contamination); later routes without reference input.

contradictions.a: The image generator is not the final designer (L03, L06).
contradictions.b: Produce a fully re-authored finished authority; the founder must not see the scaffolding (L06).
contradictions.why: No method was specified that makes a plate + overlay read as one image (no shared light, plane or occlusion rules).
contradictions.failure: Assembled, pasted-on look.

contradictions.a: Deterministic UI owns product truth (L03).
contradictions.b: The final image must feel coherent and not assembled (L06).
contradictions.why: Ownership was implemented as flat app components (bordered cards, pills, frosted boxes) in one top plane.
contradictions.failure: UI reads as a separate construction system.

contradictions.a: CENTER_STAGE: nav-bearing screens centre the field; background frames from the perimeter; no left-column drift (L01 §8, canonical refinement 3).
contradictions.b: Benchmark composition: left-led editorial column with the world on the open side (F01 approved is EDGE_LED; F03 parent is IN_REVIEW and pre-dates CENTER_STAGE).
contradictions.why: Centred product sits on the scene’s most valuable area; a rich world must then live only at the perimeter — no rule says how.
contradictions.failure: Scenes generated with quiet empty centres → plain walls, empty floors.

contradictions.a: SYSTEM CHROME ZONE; L6 SYSTEM CHROME; overlay TOP BAR / BACK / SETTINGS / INFO (L03).
contradictions.b: No device chrome (RERUN1, L06).
contradictions.why: “System chrome” was undefined; the agent’s own canonical geometry defined a 9:41 status bar and home indicator.
contradictions.failure: Execution-1 composites rendered iOS chrome.

contradictions.a: Three distinct concepts (all briefs).
contradictions.b: One fixed payload with identical presentation: same CTA slab under the object, same purchase card, same top chrome, same label→amount→date stack, same nav (RERUN1, L06).
contradictions.why: Presentation was locked along with truth, so only the background could differ.
contradictions.failure: Concepts collapse into one UI stack over three backdrops.

contradictions.a: Strict brand fidelity (palette / material lists, must-not lists).
contradictions.b: Conceptual novelty: a visual idea no generic UI generator could produce (L02 §6).
contradictions.why: Novelty was routed into data-encoding metaphors (floor area, metal words, envelope thickness); fidelity into palette nouns.
contradictions.failure: Clever diagrams in correct colours; neither rich nor editorial.

contradictions.a: Use the founder comparison concept as the quality bar; extract its lessons (L02 §15, L03 §9).
contradictions.b: The image was never supplied to the agent or committed to the repo.
contradictions.why: An unconsumable reference; lessons were extracted from prose only.
contradictions.failure: The quality bar never reached the renderer.

contradictions.a: Preserve the three structural territories; do not create new concepts (L02, L03, L06).
contradictions.b: Concepts read as diagrams / unfinished — re-author fully (L03, L06).
contradictions.why: The premises themselves (overhead plan, wall inscription, sorting rack) demand diagrammatic depiction; preserving them preserved the failure mode.
contradictions.failure: Each correction re-rendered the same diagram energy.

contradictions.a: Do not pre-bias the concepts; every number must map to a real F09 field (L01 §12, §14).
contradictions.b: The comparison concept’s features became the payload: AVAILABLE THROUGH OCT 18, BUFFER, CHECK A PURCHASE, $1,284 (L03 §6 examples, RERUN1 payload).
contradictions.why: Product truth was imported from a concept image outside the data contract (no date horizon exists in computeSafeToSpend).
contradictions.failure: Product-truth churn between rounds; not the visual failure itself.

contradictions.a: The environment IS the data object (L02 translation T01).
contradictions.b: Metaphor contained to OBJECT or ZONE (L03 §10).
contradictions.why: Sequential reversal of where the metaphor lives.
contradictions.failure: Round 2 metaphor-as-page; round 3 object floating in an empty world.

contradictions.a: Logo integrated in the scene — carved, cast, embossed (profile).
contradictions.b: The generator may not render logo geometry (L03).
contradictions.why: In-scene branding then requires compositing onto 3D surfaces, which the assembly could not do well.
contradictions.failure: Logo as a flat stamp or pasted box; mutated marks when the generator tried.

contradictions.a: Witty, bespoke, rich (L02 §6, L06).
contradictions.b: Anti-generic / anti-AI bans on botanicals, gold, 3D objects, gradients, glass, “material overload”, arches, sea views.
contradictions.why: The bans cover the vocabulary of richness without defining justified use.
contradictions.failure: Model plays safe → sparse.

contradictions.a: 393×852 product canvas.
contradictions.b: 9:16 generation with the viewport as the central 82 % (L02 §8).
contradictions.why: Different aspect ratios invite bleed confusion and device-shaped framing.
contradictions.failure: Minor crop / framing drift; status-bar thinking.

contradictions.a: Image generation is a renderer, not the designer (L02).
contradictions.b: Approved JURNL images were designed by reference: the renderer inherited composition, world and type from an approved image.
contradictions.why: The rule was read as “describe everything in words”; the approved method is “show the renderer the authority”.
contradictions.failure: Prompts grew to ~2,000 words of description instead of one attached authority.

over_constraint.failure: Concepts become backdrop swaps under one UI stack.

locked: one justified plant / olive only in the bleed

over_constraint.failure: No editorial layouts possible; the world is pushed into thin perimeters.
None in itself — but type was never allowed to touch the world (all text in one top plane).
In practice locked to a top-left stamp; in-world brand cues (book spine, seal) impossible without compositing skill.

under_specified.visual: Arched architecture opening to sea / coast; limewash and rough travertine; olive; hard warm sun with long shadows.
under_specified.minimum: ≥ 1 arch, ≥ 1 view out, ≥ 2 botanical placements, a directional sun shadow.
under_specified.structure: The world has an inside and an outside (a view).
under_specified.satisfied_badly_by: Beige plaster wall + one olive sprig.

under_specified.visual: Magazine-cover grammar: masthead lockup, one huge condensed serif word or figure, a tracked deck, a staged still life.
under_specified.minimum: Display element ≥ 56 pt; a tracked deck; one deliberate asymmetry.
under_specified.structure: Type is the hero of one zone; the image is the hero of another.
under_specified.satisfied_badly_by: Serif headline centred over a photo.

under_specified.visual: Material contrast (rough stone vs sheer linen vs velvet), restraint in UI, generous space that is lit, not empty.
under_specified.structure: Space comes from light and architecture, not from blank areas.

under_specified.visual: Few focal points, soft light, slow rhythm, no competing objects near the figure.
under_specified.structure: Calm product zone, rich world zone — not calm everywhere.

under_specified.visual: Depth planes, object relationships, texture, accent colour masses.
under_specified.minimum: ≥ 3 planes; ≥ 5 distinct objects in the world; ≥ 1 accent colour mass (burgundy / sea blue / olive).
under_specified.structure: Richness concentrated in the world zone and the foreground frame.
under_specified.satisfied_badly_by: “Rich” palette words with a single object.

under_specified.visual: Something drawn for this page that a template would not contain (a cut, a crop, a type–object relationship).
under_specified.minimum: 1 element whose form only makes sense for SAFE TO SPEND.
under_specified.structure: Designed at composition level, not as a data metaphor.

under_specified.visual: A visual relationship that rewards a second look.
under_specified.minimum: 1 relationship, stated in one sentence, that is visible without reading copy.
under_specified.structure: Lives in the world or the type–world relationship.
under_specified.satisfied_badly_by: An explanation in the prompt the viewer never sees.

under_specified.visual: Exact letters, physically plausible light, no plastic surfaces, no symmetric default layout.
under_specified.minimum: Zero glyph errors; light consistent across product and world.
under_specified.structure: Exactness via correction, not via banning content.

under_specified.visual: One image, one light, no seams (FULLY_AUTHORED_DEFINITION).
under_specified.satisfied_badly_by: Checklist PASS on a visibly assembled image.
